# Overview

rmorie reaches datasets through three routes:

- `morie_dataset_catalog()` lists the datasets that
  `morie_load_dataset()` fetches by key (CKAN portals, direct
  downloads, ArcGIS layers) and caches locally;
- `rmoriedata::mdcat()` lists the tables bundled in the
  rmoriedata package, which rmorie imports;
- `morie_sample()` reads four small OTIS and Toronto Police reference
  tables used by the MRM examples.

This vignette shows how to discover and load them from R.

# Browsing the catalogue

```{r catalog}
library(rmorie)
catalog <- morie_dataset_catalog()
dim(catalog)
head(catalog[, c("key", "name", "source", "survey", "year")])
```

Each row describes one dataset: its key (for example `ocp21` for the
CPADS 2021--2022 PUMF, or `otisb01` for OTIS table b01), its name,
source, survey, year, and where it is fetched from
(`ckan_resource_id`, `download_url`, `arcgis_url`).

# Per-dataset detail

```{r info}
str(morie_dataset_info("ocp21"))
```

`morie_dataset_info()` returns the catalogue row for one key as a
named list.

# Loading data

```{r load, eval = FALSE}
df <- morie_load_dataset("ocp21")
dim(df)
# 40931   394
```

This chunk is not run when the vignette is built: on the first call
`morie_load_dataset()` downloads the PUMF from open.canada.ca. The
copy is then kept in a per-user cache under `morie_cache_dir()` (set
`MORIE_CACHE_DIR` to move it), and `refresh = TRUE` re-downloads it.

# Bundled tables

The tables in rmoriedata need no network access:

```{r bundled}
bundled <- rmoriedata::mdcat()
nrow(bundled)
head(bundled[, c("slug", "kind", "n_rows", "n_cols")])
```

`morie_sample()` returns one of four MRM reference tables:

```{r sample}
dim(morie_sample("otis_c11"))
```

# Statistics Canada / Health Canada data acknowledgment

Several datasets in the catalogue are Statistics Canada and Health
Canada PUMFs (CCS, CSADS, CPADS and others). The standard disclaimer
applies: although the analyses use Statistics Canada / Health Canada
data, the analyses, interpretations, and conclusions are those of the
analyst and do not represent the views of either agency.
